title: Settings
subtitle: Configure Lumora for local and remote work.

general.title: General
general.description: Choose how Lumora starts, navigates, checks, and transfers context.
general.language-description: Choose the language used by Lumora-owned interface text.
general.language-rejected: {count, plural, one {# language pack could not be loaded.} other {# language packs could not be loaded.}}
general.language-open-failed: Lumora could not open the language folder.
general.language-warning-invalid: A custom language pack could not be loaded.
general.language-warning-schema: A custom language pack uses an unsupported format.
general.language-warning-catalog: A custom language pack targets a different Lumora text catalog.
general.language-warning-key: A custom language pack contains unsupported message keys.
general.start-maximized-description: Open Lumora maximized on the next launch while preserving your normal window size.
general.auto-expand-sidebar-description: Expand a collapsed sidebar when you choose a destination or use a navigation shortcut.
general.close-behavior: Keep Lumora running after closing the window
general.close-behavior-description: Hide Lumora in the tray instead of exiting and stopping managed agents.
general.warn-quit-description: Ask for confirmation before a full Lumora exit stops local or remote agents.
general.show-notices-description: Display non-critical diagnostics and helpful guidance throughout Lumora.
general.warn-quit: Warn before exiting Lumora with active agents
general.warn-remote: Warn before disconnecting a remote computer with active agents
general.warn-remote-description: Ask for confirmation before disconnecting stops agents on that remote computer.
general.cross-agent-description: Start a new provider session from a temporary local copy of another provider session.
general.retention-description: Automatically delete Lumora's managed session copies after this time.
general.show-unavailable-workspaces-description: Keep workspaces visible when their folders are not currently available.
general.show-unusable-sessions-description: Keep sessions visible when Lumora cannot currently resume them.
general.provider-updates-description: Check enabled agent providers for newer releases when provider settings open.
general.remote-disconnect: Disconnect when a remote window closes
general.remote-disconnect-description: Close its SSH connection when the remote Lumora window closes. Running remote agents require confirmation first.
general.save-error: Lumora could not save this setting.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.light-terminal: Use a light terminal in Light theme
